content.description: Illustration showing thrust bearing and races positioned in the front clutch assembly, with spring and disc components visible

items.subtext: Note the position of the races.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of thinner snap ring from the front clutch assembly with clutch plates and discs visible

items.text: REMOVE REMAINING CLUTCH PLATES AND DISCS

content.description: Illustration showing SST (Special Service Tool) being used to compress piston return springs and remove snap ring

items.text: COMPRESS PISTON RETURN SPRINGS AND REMOVE SNAP RING
substeps: Place SST on the spring retainer and compress the springs with a shop press.
Remove the snap ring with a screwdriver.

items.text: REMOVE SPRING RETAINER AND EIGHTEEN SPRINGS

content.description: Illustration showing front clutch assembly on overdrive case with cutout portion indicated for piston removal using compressed air

items.text: ASSEMBLE FRONT CLUTCH ON OVERDRIVE CASE AND BLOW OUT PISTON

substeps.text: Slide the front clutch onto the overdrive case.
Apply compressed air to the overdrive case to remove the piston. (If the piston does not come out, use pliers to remove it.)
Remove the front clutch from the overdrive case.

content.description: Illustration showing inspection of front clutch piston with compressed air being applied to check valve and check ball

substeps.text: Check the check ball is free by shaking the piston.
Check that valve does not leak by applying low-pressure compressed air.
